en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone arch bridge over a river, with people standing along the railing and children playing in the water below. On the far side of the bridge is an ornate multi‑story historic building with a steep roof and dormer windows, set among trees and additional town buildings. At the top left in red print is German text identifying the scene.
